flagsDetailed.message: PaymentRequirements are delivered via the x402 v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header only, with no PaymentRequirements in the response body. This is valid x402 v2, but clients that read the JSON body (the x402 v1 convention, still common) will not see the requirements. For maximum client compatibility, mirror the same PaymentRequirements into the response body as well (keep the header). This does not affect CDP Bazaar discovery, which indexes via CDP-facilitator settlement metadata, not the response body.
